name: weftsh-cache
description: Cache dependencies and build outputs on Weft, from any runner

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && ncc build -m -o dist/restore src/restore.ts && ncc build -m -o dist/save src/save.ts && ncc build -m -o dist/restore-only src/restoreOnly.ts && ncc build -m -o dist/save-only src/saveOnly.ts
scripts.check-dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist
